title: Reproducibility supplement for: Reference-Calibrated Selective Verification of Surrogate Design Jacobians under Finite Simulation Budgets
description: Authoritative SIMPAT revision package in simpat_revision/: frozen external-member gradients, reference-gradient step and independent-derivative verification for 3,580 components, score comparisons, query-cluster bootstrap risk-coverage analysis, finite reference-budget correction, openEMS step-ladder provenance, and deterministic figure sources. The antenna derivatives remain numerically unresolved and are excluded from quantitative reliability claims. The project-specific device PINN training framework is not bundled.
